Forward P/E 16.8 with 28% revenue growth and 44% earnings growth is a reasonable growth-at-a-reasonable-price setup versus richer AI-infra peers (e.g. RKLB's ~1,489x forward P/E, screened but passed on for this reason). AST SpaceMobile sourced from the 9/8 weekly theme screen (direct-to-cell satellite connectivity). Shifting from proof-of-concept to commercial activation: BlueBird 11-13 satellites deployed, new New Zealand gateway opened, deepening carrier integration (Vodafone/Orange/Telefonica/Deutsche Telekom via a gateway JV) and US Mobile preparing a direct-to-cell launch. 2026 revenue guided to $150-200M (vs. a near-zero prior-year base, which drove the quantitative screen's outsized revenue-growth score), backed by a $1.3B backlog and over $3.7B cash funding the buildout. Key risk is execution on an expensive, tightly-timed deployment (implied ~165%/yr revenue growth needed through 2029), but the bull case is still considered intact by sell-side (~$78 fair-value estimate vs. ~$59.27 entry). Not opportunity-tier (~$23B market cap). Sized to the remaining Technology sector-cap room (~$81.65, sector already ~28% of portfolio) rather than a full position; funded by today's VRT trim proceeds.
